svg.title: Countries represented — MedTSFM author affiliations
svg.desc: An editable vector illustration of a light blue dotted world map with six country markers and horizontal bars: China 18, Russia 8, USA 5, Canada 1, UK 1, Kenya 1. Each map dot, glow marker, connector, text label and bar is a separate vector object.

g.inkscape:label: 03 · World map dots (each circle independently editable)
